entries.title: Human
entries.subtitle: Adaptable Settlers
entries.description: Resourceful and versatile, humans form the backbone of the border garrisons and merchant guilds. Possessing balanced physical and arcane aptitudes, they adapt quickly to harsh frontier environments.

entries.title: Elf
entries.subtitle: Children of the Sylph Groves
entries.description: Elves possess acute sensory acuity, innate affinity for wind and nature magics, and remarkable physical grace. They value ancient harmony, botanical wisdom, and precision archery.

entries.title: Orc
entries.subtitle: Warriors of the Iron Ridge
entries.description: Formidable and unyielding, orcs are celebrated for their dense muscular structure, endurance, and deep metallurgical traditions. Their culture reveres martial valor and impeccable craftsmanship.

entries.title: Demon
entries.subtitle: Beings of Nether Arcana
entries.description: Entities infused with potent Nether energies, sporting horns, resilient leathery or scaled flesh, and immense destructive magical output. They are intensely passionate and driven by power.

entries.title: Beastkin
entries.subtitle: Feral Lineages
entries.description: Beings bearing animalistic ears, agile tails, and heightened predatory instincts. Highly attuned to wilderness survival, they excel as scouts, hunters, and agile skirmishers.

entries.title: Cat-morph
entries.subtitle: Feline Beastkin
entries.description: Cat-morphs possess prominent feline ears and a lithe tail, often accompanied by sharper reflexes and night-adjusted vision. They are known for their playful yet territorial demeanor.

entries.title: Half-demon
entries.subtitle: Demonic Hybrid
entries.description: Individuals infused with arcane demonic energy. They exhibit horns, pointed ears, and heightened affinity for arcane magic and emotional resonance.

entries.title: Valley's Edge Garrison
entries.subtitle: Frontier Peacekeepers
entries.description: Commanded by veteran officer Robert, the garrison defends the border valleys against rogue beasts, bandit raiders, and incursions creeping out of the Sunken Ruins.

entries.title: The Ash-Blade Bandits
entries.subtitle: Outlaw Syndicate
entries.description: A cutthroat syndicate led by Kaelen operating along the rocky passes of the Ashlands, ambushing trade caravans and harvesting forbidden relics from forgotten tombs.

entries.title: Opaque Demonstone
entries.subtitle: Arcane Focus
entries.description: A dense crystal that hums with dormant arcane energy. When equipped, it channels environmental arcane pulses into defensive shields and spell potency.

entries.title: Smartphone
entries.subtitle: Earth Device
entries.description: A personal touchscreen device that has been adapted to recharge via the user's natural arcane aura, storing maps, contacts, and journal entries.

entries.title: Rusted Keystone
entries.subtitle: Dungeon Relic
entries.description: An ancient ward-key engraved with runic ciphering, forged in the First Era to seal the lower chambers of the Sunken Ruins.

entries.title: Dark Heart Core
entries.subtitle: Abyssal Artifact
entries.description: A throbbing crystalline core extracted from corrupted fiends. It radiates malevolent heat and can either be purified or harnessed for dark transmutation.

entries.title: Valley's Edge Outpost
entries.subtitle: Frontier Stronghold
entries.description: The fortified garrison protecting the lower trade valleys against corrupted incursions from the Sunken Ruins.

entries.title: Sunken Ruins
entries.subtitle: Subterranean Complex
entries.description: A submerged subterranean fortress from a forgotten dynasty, now overrun by shadowy remnants and abyssal fiends.

entries.title: Sanctuary Manor F1
entries.subtitle: First Floor Residence
entries.description: The ground floor of the sanctuary manor, featuring stone corridors, guest quarters, research laboratories, and arcane lighting.

entries.title: Capital City
entries.subtitle: Arcane Metropolis
entries.description: The sprawling capital city constructed amidst ancient arcane ruins, bustling with various beastkin races, merchant bazaars, and guild halls.
